tools.name: pryx_categories
tools.description: Lists the product categories Pryx can give buying advice on (French market). Call this FIRST: Pryx advice is always given for a named category, never for a free-text query.

tools.name: pryx_advice
tools.description: Returns the Pryx verdict (which product to buy) for one category, once the category's questions are answered. Call it WITHOUT answers to get the questions to ask the user, then call it again with the budget and the answers. Each product carries a productUrl (its pryx.fr page with merchant prices): a

tools.name: pryx_product
tools.description: Returns current merchant offers (best 5, in EUR, French market), the lowest price ever seen and a price-history summary for ONE product, identified by its EAN. Get the EAN from the `ean` field of pryx_advice results. Read-only. Use it to answer "where is it cheapest?" or "is it a good time to buy?"

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "pryx_categories" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
